name: Almonds (California)
description: Hand-selected, jumbo-sized California almonds known for their delicate sweet crunch and rich vitamin E content. Naturally sun-ripened and pesticide-free.

name: Cashews (Whole)
description: Whole, ivory-white gourmet cashews with a natural buttery texture and melt-in-the-mouth creaminess. Packed fresh to lock in essential minerals.

name: Walnuts (Kernels)
description: Premium extra-light Chilean & Kashmiri walnut halves. Prized for their mild, non-bitter flavor and abundant plant-based Omega-3 fatty acids.

name: Pistachios (Roasted & Salted)
description: Naturally opened, slow-roasted in small batches and gently tossed with pink Himalayan rock salt for a deeply savory crunch.

name: Raisins (Golden)
description: Juicy, amber-gold seedless raisins gently sun-dried to concentrate their honeyed sweetness. Soft, plump, and free of artificial glazing.

name: Dates (Medjool)
description: Celebrated as the King of Dates, our premium Medjool dates are remarkably large, succulent, and boast a rich caramel flavor with soft fibrous flesh.

name: Dried Apricots
description: Whole sun-dried Turkish apricots with a vibrant tangy-sweet flavor profile, soft chewy texture, and high natural vitamin A concentration.

name: Dried Figs (Anjeer)
description: Naturally string-dried Turkish Anjeer packed with natural crunch and sweet floral nectar. Unbleached, sulphur-free, and rich in calcium.

name: Black Currants
description: Tart, intense, and deeply pigmented dried black currants. Bursting with anthocyanins and tangy flavor, ideal for snacking and breakfast bowls.

name: Pine Nuts
description: Ultra-rare wild harvested Himalayan Chilgoza pine nuts. Renowned worldwide for their elongated shape, delicate resinous aroma, and silky buttery taste.
